style: Children's picture-book illustration, flat shapes with soft gentle grain, thick clean rounded outlines, warm friendly faces, natural everyday colours, a full simple background scene, wide landscape picture. Everyday British setting. Original characters, not based on any existing character. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signs with writing, no logos, no brands, no watermark. Gentle, safe and cheerful: nothing scary or violent.
keep: Keep exactly the same characters, faces, hair, skin, clothes, drawing style and colours as this picture. No text, no letters, no numbers. Now show the next moment of the story, a new scene:

stories.cast: A girl of about eight with two dark plaits, brown skin, a yellow raincoat and red wellies, and her younger brother with short curly hair and a blue jumper.
pictures: In a green park on a windy day, the girl flies a bright red kite while her brother claps and points up at it.
The kite string has snapped. The red kite is stuck high in the branches of a tall tree. The girl looks up sadly and her brother holds the broken string.
A kind tall park keeper in a green jacket has brought a long ladder and climbs the tree, reaching up for the red kite, while the two children watch from the grass.
The park keeper hands the red kite back to the girl. The children smile and wave, and the kite is safe in her arms.

stories.cast: A family at a picnic: a mum with short red hair and a green top, a boy of about seven with freckles and a striped orange T-shirt, and a big shaggy golden dog.
pictures: The family sit on a checked blanket in a sunny field with sandwiches and a basket. The golden dog sits nearby looking at a big muddy puddle.
The golden dog splashes and rolls in the big muddy puddle, covered in brown mud. The boy points and laughs.
The very muddy dog has run on to the picnic blanket and shakes itself. Mud flies on to the sandwiches. The mum and boy lift their hands in surprise.
The boy and mum wash the dog in a big tin tub of soapy water beside the field. Everyone is laughing, and the dog looks clean and pleased.

stories.cast: A brother and sister of about eight and nine with black hair and warm brown skin, in blue and purple aprons. Only these two children are in the picture, with no adults.
pictures: In a bright kitchen, the brother and sister mix cake batter in a big bowl on their own. There is flour on the table and on their noses.
The two children, alone in the kitchen, spread pink icing on a round cake and add sprinkles and candles, looking very careful.

The two children crouch and hide behind a sofa in a cosy living room, holding the iced pink cake. In the doorway, their grandmother, an old lady with grey hair in a bun, round glasses and a green coat, walks in, not seeing them.

In the living room, the two children jump up holding the pink cake with its candles lit. Their grandmother, the old lady with grey hair in a bun, round glasses and a green coat, claps her hands with a big happy smile. Exactly three people in the picture.

stories.cast: A team of children in matching blue football shirts: a boy with short blond hair, a girl with a long black ponytail, and a boy with glasses and a sports strap.
pictures: On a school football pitch under a sunny sky, the children in blue shirts run after a white football, smiling.
Dark grey clouds arrive and heavy rain pours down. The children keep playing and the pitch has big puddles.
The girl with the ponytail slides through the mud and kicks the ball past a goalkeeper into the net. Her team mates cheer with their arms up, soaking wet.
The muddy team sit together in a warm changing room wrapped in towels, drinking hot chocolate from mugs and laughing.

stories.cast: Two friends of about eight: a girl with a bobble hat and a long purple coat, and a boy with dark skin, a green scarf and a thick orange coat.
pictures: In a snowy village green, the two friends roll a huge snowball together. Other children build snowmen in the distance.
The two friends put a smaller snowball on top and add a carrot nose, coal buttons and two stick arms to their snowman.
A gust of wind blows the snowman's hat and scarf away across the snow. The two friends run after them, laughing.
The snowman stands finished with its hat and scarf. A smiling teacher pins a big blue ribbon rosette on it, and the two friends jump for joy.

stories.cast: A small boy of about seven with curly brown hair and a yellow coat, his dad with a dark beard and a navy jacket, and a small brown teddy bear with one blue ear.
pictures: The boy and his dad sit on a red town bus. The boy holds the small brown teddy bear on his lap and looks out of the window.
The boy and his dad get off the bus at a bus stop. The teddy bear has been left behind on the bus seat, and the bus starts to drive away.

At home in the boy's bedroom at bedtime, the boy sits on his bed crying a little and looking into his empty bag, while his dad talks kindly to him. The teddy bear is NOT in this picture: there is no teddy anywhere in the room.
The next morning a smiling bus driver in a uniform hands the teddy bear back to the boy at the bus stop. The boy hugs his teddy and his dad smiles.

stories.cast: A girl of about nine with a brown bob and a teal coat carrying a wicker basket, and a jolly stallholder with a white apron and a big grey moustache.
pictures: At a busy outdoor town market, the girl buys apples from the stallholder at a fruit and vegetable stall. Two identical brown paper bags sit on the counter.
The stallholder hands the girl one of the two brown paper bags while he looks the other way at another customer, and she walks off happily.

At home in a kitchen, the girl is alone. She opens the brown paper bag on the table and finds a small white rabbit looking out of it, instead of apples. She stares with her mouth open. No other people in the picture.

The girl stands at the market stall and holds out the one small white rabbit. The stallholder laughs, and a little boy reaches up to take his white rabbit, smiling. There is exactly one rabbit in the picture, and it is white.

stories.cast: A class of children aged about nine: a tall girl with braids and a red cardigan, a boy with glasses and a green jumper, their smiling teacher with a brown beard, and a small ginger hamster.
pictures: In a bright primary school classroom, the children gather round a hamster cage. The small ginger hamster runs on its wheel and the cage door is slightly open.
The children find the cage empty and look shocked. The teacher looks under a table and books have been knocked over.

The children crawl around the classroom looking under cupboards, holding small modern electric pocket flashlights with plastic handles, the beams pale and soft (absolutely no fire, no flames). Behind them the small ginger hamster peeps out of a school bag.
The girl with braids gently lifts the hamster out of a lunchbox where it has been eating crumbs. Everyone laughs, and the teacher fixes the cage door.

stories.cast: A dad with a bald head and a red fleece, a girl of about ten with long dark hair and a yellow hoodie, and her younger brother with a blue bobble hat.
pictures: In a green campsite at sunset, the family try to put up a blue tent. Poles and pegs lie on the grass and the dad scratches his head at the instructions.
The tent is up but looks wonky, leaning to one side. The family stand back and look unsure as dark clouds gather and the wind blows.
In the night, under gentle rain, the tent has fallen down on top of the family. Their heads poke out from under the blue cloth, and they are laughing.
The next morning in sunshine, the family eat breakfast by a small camping stove outside a kind neighbour's big tent, while the neighbour helps put their tent up properly.

stories.cast: A girl of about ten with short black hair and an orange waterproof, her older cousin, a boy with red hair and a navy jumper, and a small white fluffy seal pup.
pictures: On a wide British beach on a grey morning, the two children walk with buckets collecting shells. There is no seal near them: the only sign is one very small white shape lying far away in the distance on the sand.
The two children stand back at a safe distance, looking at a small white fluffy seal pup alone on the sand, tangled in a piece of old green fishing net. The girl uses a phone.
A kind rescuer in a bright jacket gently cuts the net away from the calm seal pup, while the two children watch from behind a rope.
Some weeks later, at the edge of the sea, the rescuer opens a carrier and the healthy seal pup slides into the waves. The children wave goodbye happily.

stories.cast: A boy of about eleven with short dark hair and a mustard jumper, and his great-aunt, an old lady with white hair, a long cardigan and a walking stick.
pictures: In a dusty attic with sunlight from a small window, the boy finds an old wooden box under a blanket, among old suitcases.
The boy opens the box and finds a bundle of old letters tied with ribbon and a small black and white photograph. He looks curious.
At a kitchen table, the boy shows the letters to his great-aunt. She puts a hand to her heart with a soft smile and tears of happiness in her eyes.
The boy and his great-aunt stand at the door of a cottage hugging a very old man with a walking stick, an old friend she has not seen for many years. Everyone is smiling.

stories.cast: A girl of about eleven with curly black hair and a lab coat over a purple T-shirt, and her best friend, a boy with spiky fair hair and a teal hoodie, and a small home-made cardboard robot on wheels.
pictures: In a school hall at a science fair, the two friends stand proudly beside a table with their small cardboard robot on wheels, while judges with clipboards walk towards them.
The robot rolls off the table on its own and speeds across the hall. The two friends chase it and other children's projects wobble on the tables.
The robot bumps into a tall tower of paper cups at another table, and the cups rain down gently around a surprised judge. The friends cover their mouths in horror.
The two friends and the other children rebuild the cup tower together and the laughing judge hands them a small gold star sticker. The robot sits safely in the girl's arms.
